subject: math
cluster: Measure lengths indirectly and by iterating length units

items.prompt:
A ribbon is $6$ paper clips long. How many units?
A) $6$
B) $5$
C) $7$
D) $1$

A pencil is $5$ cubes long. How many units?
A) $4$
B) $5$
C) $6$
D) $10$

Should length units have gaps between them?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only big ones
D) Sometimes

A book is $8$ paper clips long. That is
A) $8$ units
B) $9$ units
C) $7$ units
D) $1$ unit

A straw is $4$ cubes, a marker is $7$ cubes. How much longer is the marker?
A) $3$ units
B) $11$ units
C) $4$ units
D) $2$ units

Why lay units end to end with no overlaps?
A) So the measurement is accurate
B) To use more units
C) To make it longer
D) No reason
items.answer: A) So the measurement is accurate

items.prompt:

B) $13$ units

D) $4$ units

A) $10$ units
